dedupe_keys.name: district heating economic assessment module dh potential and grid costs

description: This module estimates the economic potential of district heating and its grid costs at pre-feasibility stage from two GIS layers. It is developed by Mostafa Fallahnejad, with releases v1.0 (December 2022) and v1.1, and is the method behind the 2024 Applied Energy paper on district heating potential in the EU-27 under heat demand reduction and market share growth. Inputs are a heat demand density raster and a heated gross floor area density raster at 1 hectare resolution in the European EPSG:3035 grid; outputs are written to a folder and summarised in an Excel table. It was built for EU countries and, per its Zenodo description, can be applied elsewhere with simple code changes. Coverage is Europe by default. The code is accessible on GitHub and Zenodo at no cost; the repository licence file states CC BY-SA 4.0, while the Zenodo v1.0 record states Apache 2.0. Caveats: the licence differs between sources, and input rasters must be prepared separately. Simulation uses are screening district heating expansion areas and network cost estimation for heat planning. Related records: data-hotmaps-electricity-district-heating-scenarios and data-europe-district-heating-areas-excess-heat-potentials are European heat planning data.
inputs: heat demand density raster (1 ha, EPSG:3035)
heated gross floor area density raster (1 ha, EPSG:3035)
name: District heating economic assessment module (DH potential and grid costs)
outputs: district heating potential areas and grid costs (rasters and Excel table)
